# Understanding the Rejection of Fixes Generated by Agentic Pull Requests -- Insights from the AIDev Dataset

> **Source:** [arXiv](http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13468v1)
> **Category:** Artificial_Intelligence/LLM

## Summary

AI coding agents are increasingly used to generate pull requests (PRs) that propose code fixes in software projects.
